summary: Recent updates to the negotiation engine for Firefox's WebRTC capabilities bring several enhancements that improve stability and performance during multimedia sessions. **Distinct errors for SDP (Session Description Protocol) parsing failures** have been introduced, which will help developers quickly identify and address issues when setting up video calls or streaming sessions. Additionally, RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) header extensions have been optimized for better memory management, ensuring smoother operation when dealing with audio and video data. Finally, the implementation of stricter filtering for remote entries that might clash with local identifiers helps maintain a clean and error-free communication channel, making real-time interactions more reliable. These improvements collectively enhance user experience by ensuring smoother and more robust video calling and streaming in the Firefox browser.
